subject.title: feat: add Messages Name & Photo sharing

question: Should this PR retain the two policy-oriented fallback selectors without receiver-visible proof, or fail closed unless the explicit four-argument force-send selector is available?
rationale: Source inspection and deterministic tests establish the guard structure but cannot prove whether the undocumented fallback selectors transmit the profile, merely update policy, or remain safe across supported macOS versions.

options.title: Prove every retained selector
options.body: Keep the draft until the exact head demonstrates liveness plus sender- and receiver-visible behavior for each supported selector branch.

options.title: Require force-send only
options.body: Remove the two-argument fallback branches and fail closed on runtimes without the explicit force-send selector.

options.title: Accept fallback uncertainty
options.body: Retain all branches while intentionally owning possible policy-only behavior, non-delivery, and future macOS drift.

recommendation.title: Prove every retained selector
recommendation.body: Keep the draft until the exact head demonstrates liveness plus sender- and receiver-visible behavior for each supported selector branch.
